target.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:
target.body: ### Bug type Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash) ### Beta release blocker No ### Summary On my hosted Molty instance (usemolty.com), every agent reply fails because the Anthropic API receives the model id claude-opus-4.8 (with a dot) instead of the valid claude-opus-4-8 (with a hyphen). Switching the active brain in the UI does not change this — the same dotted id is sent regardless of my selection. This was discussed on Discord; a maintainer confirmed that main's direct API default is correctly hyphenated (anthropic/claude-opus-4-8), but that the Anthropic extension/catalog still contains compatibility/catalog entries for the dotted claude-opus-4.8. The likely cause is that hosted Molty resolves the UI selection through that dotted catalog id, which explains both symptoms. Exact error text Agent failed before reply: LLM error not_found_error: model: claude-opus-4.8 was not found. Did you mean claude-opus-4-8?. Logs: openclaw logs --follow Environment / context Hosted instance: usemolty.com (Molty), not a local install Access limited to the .md files + the "Brain & Keys" panel — no config file or CLI access Anthropic API key is added and valid ### Steps to reproduce 1. Add a valid Anthropic API key in Brain & Keys. 2. Select any active brain (tested with Opus 4.8, then Sonnet 4.6, then Fable 5). 3. Send any message to the agent. ### Expected behavior The agent sends the request using the model matching the selected brain, with the valid hyphenated Anthropic model id (e.g. claude-opus-4-8). ### Actual behavior The request always fails with the error above, referencing claude-opus-4.8 (dotted), regardless of which brain is selected. The selection does not appear to persist/apply. Selected brain before the failed run Fable 5 (error still referenced claude-opus-4.8). Same result previously with Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8. Approximate timestamp of a failed run (UTC) 15.00 UTC, 2026-07-07 ### OpenClaw version molty ### Operating system Mac OS Tahoe 26.5.1 ### Install method Molty ### Model antrophic sonnet 5 ### Provider / routing chain molty ### Additional provider/model setup details _No response_ ### Logs ```shell ``` ### Screenshots, recordings, and evidence ### Impact and severity _No response_ ### Additional information _No response_
